info.title: Linear
info.description: Linear is a modern issue tracking and project management tool for software teams. This connector enables creating, updating, and querying issues in your Linear workspace from Power Automate flows.

post.description: Retrieves all teams in the Linear workspace.

query.default: query ListTeams { teams { nodes { id name key description icon color } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of teams.

key.description: Short key for the team (e.g. ENG).

post.description: Retrieves all workflow states (statuses) in the workspace.

query.default: query ListWorkflowStates { workflowStates { nodes { id name type color position team { id name } } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of workflow states.

type.description: Type: backlog, unstarted, started, completed, or canceled.

post.description: Retrieves all users in the Linear workspace.

query.default: query ListUsers { users { nodes { id name displayName email active admin avatarUrl } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of users.

admin.description: Whether the user is an admin.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the user avatar image.

post.description: Creates a new issue in Linear.

query.default: mutation CreateIssue($teamId: String!, $title: String!, $description: String, $stateId: String, $assigneeId: String, $priority: Int, $dueDate: TimelessDate, $estimate: Int, $labelIds: [String!]) { issueCreate(input: { teamId: $teamId, title: $title, description: $description, stateId: $stateId, assigneeId: $assigneeId, priority: $priority, dueDate: $dueDate, estimate: $estimate, labelIds: $labelIds }) { success issue { id identifier title description url createdAt state { id name } assignee { id name } team { id name } } } }

teamId.description: Team ID where the issue will be created. Get from List Teams.

stateId.description: Workflow state ID. If omitted, defaults to first Backlog state.

assigneeId.description: User ID to assign the issue to. Get from List Users.

labelIds.description: Array of label IDs to apply. Get from List Labels.

200.description: Successful response with created issue details.

success.description: Whether the issue was created successfully.

url.description: Linear web URL for the issue.

post.description: Retrieves a single issue by ID or identifier.

query.default: query GetIssue($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { id identifier title description url createdAt updatedAt dueDate estimate priority state { id name type } assignee { id name email } creator { id name } team { id name key } labels { nodes { id name color } } } }

post.description: Lists issues with optional filtering and pagination.

query.default: query ListIssues($first: Int, $after: String) { issues(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: updatedAt) { nodes { id identifier title url createdAt updatedAt priority state { id name type } assignee { id name } team { id name key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

first.description: Number of items to return (default 50, max 100).

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use endCursor from previous response.

200.description: Successful response with list of issues.

endCursor.description: Cursor to pass as after for next page.

post.description: Updates an existing issue in Linear.

query.default: mutation UpdateIssue($id: String!, $title: String, $description: String, $stateId: String, $assigneeId: String, $priority: Int, $dueDate: TimelessDate, $estimate: Int, $labelIds: [String!]) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: { title: $title, description: $description, stateId: $stateId, assigneeId: $assigneeId, priority: $priority, dueDate: $dueDate, estimate: $estimate, labelIds: $labelIds }) { success issue { id identifier title description url updatedAt state { id name } assignee { id name } } } }

stateId.description: New workflow state ID. Get from List Workflow States.

assigneeId.description: New assignee user ID. Get from List Users.

dueDate.description: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

labelIds.description: New array of label IDs (replaces existing labels).

200.description: Successful response with updated issue details.

post.description: Retrieves all issue labels in the workspace.

query.default: query ListLabels { issueLabels { nodes { id name description color team { id name } } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of labels.

post.description: Creates a comment on an existing issue.

query.default: mutation AddComment($issueId: String!, $body: String!) { commentCreate(input: { issueId: $issueId, body: $body }) { success comment { id body createdAt user { id name } issue { id identifier } } } }

200.description: Successful response with created comment details.

success.description: Whether the comment was created successfully.

post.description: Searches issues by text in title or description.

query.default: query SearchIssues($searchText: String!, $first: Int, $after: String) { searchIssues(term: $searchText, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id identifier title description url createdAt state { id name } assignee { id name } team { id name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

searchText.description: Text to search for in issue titles and descriptions.

teamId.description: Filter search results by team ID.

first.description: Number of items to return (default 50, max 100).

endCursor.description: Cursor to pass as after for next page.

post.summary: When an issue is created or updated
post.description: Triggers when a Linear issue is created or updated.
post.x-ms-trigger-hint: Polls Linear for new or updated issues.

query.default: query PollIssues($first: Int) { issues(first: $first, orderBy: updatedAt) { nodes { id identifier title url description createdAt updatedAt priority state { id name type } assignee { id name email } team { id name key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

first.description: Number of issues to return per poll (default 20, max 100).
